bio: For those on a quest for a gastronomic experience rather than just a simple meal, this restaurant offering a combination of fine wine and fine dining is the perfect option. Occupying a glass-fronted annexe with views of the vineyards at the entrance to the prestigious Trapiche winery, Espacio Trapiche features an open-view kitchen visible from the entrance hall (part of the floor is covered with glass to enable guests to view the underground wine cellar below) as well as an attractive contemporary-style dining room.
